# Construct test grid and candidate nested-rectangle fill
n=30
G=[[6]*n for _ in range(n)]
# 4 divider lines
for r in range(0,7): G[r][8]=4
for c in range(0,9): G[6][c]=4
for r in range(30): G[r][22]=4
for c in range(30): G[21][c]=4
for c in range(13,23): G[14][c]=4
for r in range(14,22): G[r][13]=4
# source markers
for r,c,v in [(4,6,7),(5,7,2),(11,19,7),(12,20,2),(13,21,8),(15,14,7),(16,15,9),(18,25,8),(19,24,1),(20,23,5),(22,21,7),(23,20,3),(24,19,8),(28,24,3),(29,23,8)]: G[r][c]=v
# Room fill: [r0,r1), [c0,c1), ring color sequence from a corner
O=[row[:] for row in G]
def paint(r0,r1,c0,c1,seq):
    for r in range(r0,r1):
        for c in range(c0,c1):
            k=min(r-r0,r1-1-r,c-c0,c1-1-c)
            O[r][c]=seq[k%len(seq)]

print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in O))

def parse_demo(text, idx=1):
    pat=rf'Demo pair {idx} input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair {idx} output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?:\n\nSame instance|\nWrong attempts)'
    m=re.search(pat,text,re.S)
    if not m: print('no match'); return
    h,w=map(int,m.group(1,2)); inp=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in m.group(3).splitlines()]; out=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in m.group(4).splitlines()]
    print(h,w,len(inp),len(out))
    return inp,out
for k,t in enumerate(user_msgs[1:5],1):
    d=parse_demo(t,k); print(k, bool(d))
